name: @gamely/core-native-html5
author: RodrigoDornelles
description: create your own game-engine with just javascript or lua.

scripts.step2: cd ../.. && node cli.js bundler js npm/core-native-html5/src/index.js --outfile dist/dist/index.js --global CoreNativeHtml5
scripts.step3: cd ../.. && node cli.js meta source/cli/main.lua --infile npm/core-native-html5/package.json --outfile dist/package.json
scripts.build: npm run step1 && npm run step2 && npm run step3
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run check
